entities.summary: Theodore Roosevelt, also known as Teddy or T.R., was the 26th president of the United States, serving from 1901 to 1909. He was briefly vice president under William McKinley and assumed the presidency after McKinley's assassination in 1901. He was also closely involved in New York state politics and served as Governor of New York from 1899 to 1900. As president, Roosevelt pushed for antitrust and Progressive Era policies, which earned him much popular support.
